_comment: Canonical listing store. Statuses reflect VERIFICATION state. Nothing is status 'match' unless it appeared in Redfin's live active-listing feed AND its MLS 'Pool Information' amenity block confirms a private pool. See README 'Verification gate'.

source.name: Redfin gis-csv live MLS feed + per-listing MLS amenity data
source.method: Three overlapping map polygons covering 95682/95672/95667, each returning under the 350-row API cap so coverage is complete; every candidate then confirmed on its own listing page.

dataQuality.note: Network egress to Redfin opened up as of this run, so listing status is now read from a live active-listings feed rather than inferred from search-engine text. All six matches were cross-checked against both the MLS amenity block and the listing description.
